note: GMUG (Gunnison NF, Paonia RD) campground on Anthracite Creek off Kebler Pass Rd (CR 12), in dense spruce/fir forest that gets little sun, so it runs cool. The Dark Canyon Trailhead (Raggeds Wilderness, horse-trailer parking) is just past the campground; OHVs ride FR 795 north from it. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed first-come only, $14 (+$7 vehicle), vault toilet, no potable water, late spring-early fall. Cleared the note-derived 35-ft max and pull-through (FS: sites 'can accommodate smaller camping trailers'). Note trimmed of the restated sites/fees/season/amenities.
flags: CRITERIA (rig-length wording): the FS page singles this campground out - 'Each site has a tent pad and can accommodate smaller camping trailers' - and gives no length. Not Paonia RD boilerplate: the McClure and Lost Lake pages carry no such wording. No agency length anywhere (recreation.gov is Scan and Pay only, no site catalog). No review from the last 3 years in which the reviewer's own 23 ft+ rig fit was found (Campendium's only report is from Aug 2023 with no written text). Whether EKKO fits is unverified.

Pin 38.9552,-107.2692 sits on the Anthracite Creek channel by the day-use/picnic area near the bridge, ~270 m from the FS point (38.956703,-107.26681, at the campground road entrance) and ~300-350 m SW of the camping loops, which run NE along the campground road toward the Dark Canyon Trailhead (approx. 38.9573,-107.2660 on imagery). Suggest moving the pin onto the loops.

Waterfront (stored creekside): no per-site coordinates. On imagery Anthracite Creek here is a braided channel ~30-80 m wide including gravel bars (wetted channel ~20-30 m); the campground road and loops run parallel to it ~30-80 m away behind a tree band, with most sites in the forest SE of the road. Whether any site reaches an open bank is unconfirmed; the stored creekside is a re-audit lead, not changed.
FS 'Current Conditions' reads 'NO SERVICE OR RESERVATIONS' (same banner on other Paonia RD campgrounds; status 'Site Open'); not a closure.
Website: the recreation.gov link stored first is an information/Scan and Pay listing only; the FS page (stored second) is the campground's page and could go first.
